newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plummet on economic uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plummet on economic uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plummeted on Sunday on what dealers called lack of clarity about the caretaker government's plan of action on the economic front.
Pakistan's new finance chief Shahid Javed Burki said on the interim cabinet would announce a structural reform package by mid-December to help stabilise the economy.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 31.72 points, or 2.10 percent, to end at 1,480.14. Losers led gainers 146 to 85. Turnover fell to 40.91 million shares from 46.80 million in the previous session on Thursday.
Faysal Bank fell 1.25 rupees to 24.15, Bank of Punjab 1.40 to 18.35, Cherat Cement 0.50 to 20.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 3.30 to 31.60.
Hub Power Co fell 0.05 to 34.80, Pakistan State Oil 6.0 to 388, PTCL 0.60 to 31.80, Fauji Fetilizer 5.50 to 79 and ICI Pakistan 1.90 to 17.70.
